use_case: AI eligibility pre-screening (SYS-09): reads application documents and suggests likely eligible, likely ineligible, or needs information to AC-02 caseworkers for the county-funded Emergency Assistance Program
vendor_or_model: Platform vendor's generative AI add-on with a model from the vendor's subprocessor (outside the vendor's SOC 2 report and FedRAMP authorization)
data_categories: Applicant and household data; income documents and benefit award letters; Social Security numbers (Restricted)
human_in_the_loop: County caseworkers make every decision. Add-on off from 2026-09-01; restart (extraction only) requires masking, review-first design, deterministic income check, and applicant notice; suggestions return only after the bias test passes
applicable_laws: 28 CFR 35.130(b)(1), (b)(3), (b)(8) (ADA Title II; the county is a public entity, 28 CFR 35.104); 42 U.S.C. 2000d and 2000d-4a (Title VI; county confirmed federal financial assistance to the department); Fla. Stat. 119.071(5)(a) (Social Security numbers); Fla. Stat. 119.0701(2)(b) (public records); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); AC-02 contract (5-business-day decision rule and appeal notice)
status: Pilot (6 caseworkers since 2026-06-01); approved with conditions; switched off from 2026-09-01

use_case: General-purpose public generative AI tools (chatbots and coding assistants) for drafting, summarizing, or writing scripts
data_categories: Risk that agency data, interface scripts with credentials, or security documents are pasted in
risk_tier: High if agency data is entered; Low for public, non-sensitive text
applicable_laws: POL-04 4.6 and POL-02 C.2 (approved tools only); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9) if CJI were entered; N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(3)) for FTI, which never leaves the agency virtual desktop; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: Not approved. Prohibited for agency data, credentials, and security documents; staff told at the 2026-09-15 briefing

use_case: Platform vendor's AI text summary of case notes (built-in feature, available in every workspace)
